verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a real end-to-end flow — checkout session creation, a delegated one-time-use payment credential (Braintree nonce or Google Pay tokenized credential), and a confirmed order via merchant-hosted cart/checkout endpoints — across ACP (ChatGPT), UCP (Google AI Mode), and Store Sync. However, this comes with significant caveats: it requires a Braintree merchant account, form-gated access approval, Google-specific enablement for UCP, and Store Sync is currently limited to US-based physical goods in USD; there's no independent/hands-on evidence of an actual live agent completing a purchase in production. missing for 10: independent verification of a real agent completing a live purchase, and evidence the flow works without the Braintree/geography/access-gate constraints.
